name: pabbar
description: Root orchestrator for the pabbar backend, frontend and Docker services.

scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:be: npm run docker:up && npm --prefix backend run start:dev
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
